name: ai.robosystems/xbrlkit
title: xbrlkit
description: Read SEC EDGAR and XBRL filings with an AI: 18 tools over the filing itself. Local, free, no account

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server is the package's optional [mcp] extra; this pulls it into the uvx environment.

environmentVariables.name: SEC_GOV_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Your name and email, sent to EDGAR as the User-Agent when a filing is fetched from sec.gov. Optional: EDGAR works unattributed under the default, and local files, filings.xbrl.org and JSON reports need no identity.
